answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduced the DISCO framework for distilling high-quality counterfactual data from large language models (LLMs) using a task-specific teacher model for NLI.
answer_1.outputs: counterfactual text perturbations for Natural Language Inference

answer_2.quote: We use Self-BLEU (Zhu et al., 2018) to measure the diversity of the generated counterfactual examples.

answer_4.quote: We recruit human workers on Amazon Mechanic Turk to annotate labels for the two datasets.
answer_4.guideline: We assigned three annotators for each example and did majority voting on the annotated labels. We only give annotators the new sentence pairs to avoid bias from the original example.
